parts.note: One objective: smallest legal behavioral GREEN. Reuse, scope limits and construction constraints specify that objective. Governed-loop phase and acceptance are gates; wording, language and findings are explicitly not gates. The original narrow structural exception survives.
One objective: behavior-preserving, sensor-guided REFACTOR after first pass. Open findings are not required for activation. Already-satisfied sensors need no ceremonial changes.

One conditional obligation: real-owner production wiring for newly implemented behavior flagged as unreachable. Passing-acceptance context fits false GREEN; completion remains the deadline. No artificial-import waiver is introduced.

One completion gate: combined behavioral and full-profile proof. Fires on declaring completion even without a new change; profile-set observation identifies applicable profiles rather than requiring an existing failure.
